item.title: Best Nail Tool Brands for Building a Pro-Level Kit
item.description: Personal grooming ritual has undergone a radical transformation. We no longer view the "at-home manicure" as a mere stopgap between salon visits. Instead, it has become a sophisticated art form practiced in the comfort of our own living rooms. As trailblazing nail educator Tammy Taylor once said, “There is so much beauty and elegance in a great set of nails.” To achieve that elegance, however, the tools you use must match your ambition.

item.title: Working With Creative Studio Teams To Design Impactful Case Exhibits
item.description: Visuals play a huge role in how people understand complex stories. In a legal setting, explaining technical details with words alone leads to confusion. Working with a creative team helps turn dense information into clear pictures for the jury.

item.title: Historic 1954 Deepwater Bluff Estate in Riverland Terrace Hits Market for First Time in 70 Years
item.description: The bluff-top home at 111 Riverland Drive in Riverland Terrace has entered the public market for the first time since its construction in 1954 by the Halsey family, longtime owners of W.B. Halsey Lumber Company.

item.title: Charleston Symphony Announces 2026-2027 Season
item.description: The Charleston Symphony Orchestra’s (CSO) 2026-2027 season invites audiences to experience a year defined by storytelling, artistic ambition, and the commanding sound of the orchestra in full force.

item.title: Brookgreen Gardens Unveils Exceptionally Rare 1927 Diana "Straight 8" Sedan in Rosen Galleries
item.description: Brookgreen Gardens is proud to announce the debut of an extraordinarily rare 1927 Diana "Straight 8" fully restored 4‑Door Sedan, now on public display in the Polack Gallery of the Rosen Galleries.

item.title: Empower Charleston Announces 2026 Investment Grant Cycle – Applications Now Open
item.description: Empower Charleston is pleased to announce the launch of its 2026 Investment Grant Cycle and is now officially accepting applications from nonprofit organizations across the Tri-County region.
